expected_skill_registry_entries.statement: discriminator features are SUPPLIED evidence (construction, entry, paradigm); the consumer never reads them off the skeleton, which is shared by all five readings
the rival readings differ in PART OF SPEECH, not in nuance: two adjectival readings, one adjectival degree split, and two verbal readings all spell the same letters
degree is fixed by CONSTRUCTION, not by form: a comparison complement selects the comparative; the definite article or an immediately following genitive selects the superlative
the two superlative constructions EXCLUDE the comparison complement; a surface carrying both is not resolved by this table

the feminine counterpart template is evidence, not a consequence: the elative's counterpart and the colour adjective's counterpart are different templates, and which one the lexeme takes is a lexical fact
exactly one survivor -> that reading (candidate); more than one -> preserve_alternatives; none -> abstain insufficient_features. There is NO default reading for this skeleton
the classical conditions restricting which bases admit an elative at all are not encoded here, so a surviving elative reading is a candidate about THIS occurrence and never a licence to build one
whether sequence and otherness items belong to the elative inventory is disputed in the tradition and is not decided by this table
